# Versions of the Python-packaged tools the checks run, kept here so that
# Dependabot's pip ecosystem updates them. Callers pass this file to
# `uvx --constraints`, which binds the version of the tool they name, so the
# version lives in one place instead of in each command.
#
# The `gh-actions-lock` extension is pinned in .github/workflows/checks.yml
# instead: it is not a Python package, and Dependabot has no ecosystem for gh
# extensions.
